items.html: *We shall first explain the place of these thirteen corrections of the beard, according to what is written in the Idra of Naso, page 131, side A, and afterward we shall explain their essence. Behold, the two corners of the head are the aspect of the tenth Malchut of the ten Sefirot of the Galgalta, as was said, and beneath them begin the corrections of the concealed Hochma, which are the thirteen corrections of the beard.
